evidence_items.locator: Second body paragraph, following the reported billion-user milestone
evidence_items.explanation: Sensor Tower reports that ChatGPT reached one billion mobile monthly active users in May 2026. This strongly establishes mass adoption, but does not by itself establish the transformative application-ecosystem component.
OpenAI launched tools for third-party applications inside ChatGPT and named initial partners. The announcement establishes a platform initiative, not its eventual breadth or durable use.

unresolved_gaps: The reviewed records do not quantify sustained third-party application use or establish a transformation comparable to the iPhone.
